objective: Build an evidence-first agentic commerce marketplace using existing DreamLedger, AgentBridge, CUBE, Gauntlet, payment and fulfillment substrate.

workstreams.name: 777 reliability and compounding
tasks: Verify workflow registration and latest run
Record job-level evidence not just run badge
Hash and deduplicate each artifact
Run site build and deployment health checks
Write Airtable snapshot and Notion receipt
Preserve rollback and kill-switch paths
workstreams.done_when: Each cycle proves external revenue or commits a useful non-duplicate artifact with verifier output

workstreams.name: First-dollar commerce rail
tasks: Trace existing quote-comparison checkout to canonical order
Verify settled payment attribution
Verify entitlement, fulfillment request, delivery proof
Repair first failed boundary
workstreams.done_when: Independent paid buyer completes delivery and evidence is recorded

workstreams.name: AgentBridge A2A toll
tasks: Validate manifest schema
Add scoped entitlement and idempotency checks
Measure per-call cost and margin
Emit signed usage receipt
Add bounded retry and rate-limit behavior
workstreams.done_when: A permitted machine client completes a metered call and reconciles its receipt

workstreams.name: Reusable digital goods exchange
tasks: Define canonical listing metadata
Add version and licence validation
Add content-hash dedupe
Package templates, stencils, word banks, boilerplates and connectors
Add deterministic acceptance tests
workstreams.done_when: One asset can be listed, paid for, version-pinned, delivered and verified

workstreams.name: Free B2B demand surfaces
tasks: Build free worksheet and useful calculators
Corroborate every public signal at primary source
Generate source-bound pages with distinct user value
Publish small cohorts and measure indexing and conversion
Prune or update stale pages
workstreams.done_when: Analytics measures qualified human visits and conversion without thin-page inflation

workstreams.name: Safe GPU capacity exchange
tasks: Benchmark real local GPU capacity
Define opt-in availability and owner-priority policy
Run inference in isolated sandbox
Enforce time, memory, network and storage quotas
Strip secrets and define data retention
Add watchdog and emergency stop
workstreams.done_when: A bounded test job completes with measured cost and verifiable receipt without host exposure

workstreams.name: Marketplace trust and fulfilment
tasks: Canonical listing and entitlement integration
Version pinning and licence receipts
Refund and dispute path
Delivery evidence and repeat-purchase telemetry
Trust and reputation based on verified events
workstreams.done_when: Buyer can discover, purchase, receive, inspect and dispute one digital asset

workstreams.name: DOOH inventory adapter
tasks: Define placement and time-slot schema
Capture vendor permissions and creative constraints
Model price and proof-of-play
Simulate booking and reporting
Add approval gate before spend or publication
workstreams.done_when: A sandbox campaign produces a complete proof-of-play report; no spend without approval

workstreams.name: Carbon forward evidence-gated pre-screen
tasks: Run deterministic matcher against valid, stale-evidence, revoked-consent and price-mismatch fixtures
Keep all match proposals non-binding and require human review
Publish schema at /.well-known/carbon-forward-schema.json and verify live route
Record CI test output and schema parity
workstreams.done_when: Repeatable tests pass for positive, negative and digest-reproducibility cases; no trade or revenue claim is made without external evidence

cycle_contract.input: Existing observed economic signals and current repository state
output: one tested reusable component or useful public artifact
cycle_contract.truth_rule: Internal work, traffic, model output, test payments and workflow success are not revenue.
